summary: Bank7 Corp. filed an 8-K announcing it was named the successful bidder in a court-supervised auction to acquire approximately 71% of Century Financial Services Corporation from a receivership estate for a net cash price of about $89.0 million (final bid $91.0 million including a ~$2.0 million breakup fee credit). The auction followed an initial Stock Purchase Agreement dated July 1, 2026, at $68.0 million for 237,136 shares. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and court processes. Watch for antitrust and banking regulatory review timelines.
